name: Grilled arowana
nameVi: cá hải tượng nướng muối ớt
summary: Arowana grilled with salt and chili. Người Lao Động seasons it with salt and satay, grills it over charcoal, and serves green chili salt and herbs. Báo Quốc tế names the dish and does not describe the fire.
origin: Củ Chi. Người Lao Động says the dish is recent there and describes the grilling. No street was printed.
howToEat: Người Lao Động: salt and satay, charcoal, then a dip of green chili salt, with herbs. The same account says the fish also suits hotpot, and does not describe a hotpot.
Báo Quốc tế names cá hải tượng nướng muối ớt among countryside dishes and prints no method.
